details.headline: The image editor you already know how to use.
about: Layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors and brushes in a native app written in Rust. Open source, offline, and yours.
PhotoCraft keeps the menus, shortcuts and panels your hands already know, so there is nothing to relearn.

features.title: Native GPU canvas
features.text: No Electron and no web view: a fast native compositor.

features.title: Real layered files
features.text: Opens and saves layered PSD and PSB documents.

features.title: Non-destructive editing
features.text: Adjustment layers, live-preview filters, smart objects and layer styles.

features.title: On-device selection
features.text: Subject and object selection and mask refinement run locally.

features.title: Serious color
features.text: 8-, 16- and 32-bit RGB, CMYK, Lab and Grayscale, with ICC color management and soft proofing.

details.headline: Vector illustration, reimagined in pure Rust.
about: A native vector illustration app with the pen, panels and shortcuts illustrators expect. Open source, and it also runs in a browser.

features.title: The workflow you know
features.text: Pen, direct selection, shape booleans, snapping guides and an appearance panel, laid out the way you expect.

features.title: Genuinely fast
features.text: Drawings with thousands of shapes stay responsive on a retina display.

features.title: Booleans that don't fail
features.text: Shape booleans work on the exact curves, so there is no "cannot perform operation", and undo is unlimited.

features.title: Live, editable effects
features.text: Blends, envelope distort, gradient mesh, repeats, glows and drop shadows all stay editable.

features.title: Image tracing
features.text: Turn raster images into clean vector paths, with presets for the common cases.

features.title: Open formats
features.text: Native JSON documents, SVG and PDF import and export, and PNG, JPEG and WebP output.

shots.caption: A feature sheet and the Layers panel

details.headline: Professional video editing, rebuilt from scratch.
about: A native video editor written in pure Rust, with source and program monitors, a real timeline and every trim mode.

features.title: A timeline you already know
features.text: Source and program monitors, three-point editing, every trim mode and J/K/L trimming.

features.title: Frame-exact time
features.text: An integer timebase keeps 23.976 and 29.97 drop-frame footage exact, with no drift.

features.title: Its own codecs
features.text: No FFmpeg inside: native support for H.264, HEVC, ProRes, VP9, AAC and Opus.

features.title: Color grading
features.text: Curves, color wheels, HSL secondaries, LUTs and HDR and log workflows, with scopes to check the result.

features.title: Effects and keyframes
features.text: Video effects and transitions, keyframes with value and velocity graphs, and a linear-light GPU compositor.

features.title: Broadcast-ready audio
features.text: EBU R128 loudness meters, a mixer with automation and native audio effects.

details.headline: Your photos. Your pixels. Your machine.
about: A fast photo library and non-destructive raw developer, written from scratch in pure Rust. No account, no cloud, no telemetry and no subscription.

features.title: Non-destructive by design
features.text: A wide-gamut, 32-bit float pipeline that never touches your originals.

features.title: Every control you reach for
features.text: Light, color, effects, tone curve, a color mixer, color grading wheels and built-in presets.

features.title: Precise masking
features.text: Brush, gradient and range masks, plus sky, subject and background masks.

features.title: Native raw decoding
features.text: Pure-Rust decoders for the main camera raw formats: DNG, CR2, ARW, NEF, RAF, RW2, PEF and ORF.

features.title: A library that keeps up
features.text: Albums, ratings, flags and search, with grids that stay smooth on large catalogs.

features.title: Instant feedback
features.text: The GPU pipeline updates the preview as you move a slider, even on large raw files.

shots.caption: A radial mask over a sky mask

details.headline: The open-source PDF workbench.
about: Read, organize, combine, split and secure PDFs in a fast, native app written in Rust from the ground up. No account, no telemetry and no cloud.

features.title: Faithful rendering
features.text: World scripts, vertical Japanese, color emoji and transparency.

features.title: Search as you type
features.text: Instant find, and text selection that follows the document's real reading order.

features.title: Organize like cards
features.text: Rotate, delete, insert and reorder pages, with deep undo behind every change.

features.title: Combine, extract, split
features.text: Assemble and break apart documents while keeping links, form fields, layers and bookmarks intact.

features.title: Fearless saves
features.text: Incremental, atomic saves with autosave and crash recovery.

features.title: Built-in security
features.text: Opens files from RC4 to AES-256 encryption and honors the author's permissions.

details.headline: Motion graphics and visual effects, in pure Rust.
about: A native compositor with compositions, layers, keyframes, effects, expressions, 3D cameras and lights, and a render queue. Young, moving fast, and already usable.

features.title: Animate the way you know
features.text: Familiar panels and keyframes (linear, bezier, hold and eased), with a graph editor for value and speed curves.

features.title: Layers of every kind
features.text: Solids, shapes, text, footage, nested compositions, nulls and adjustment layers, with parenting, track mattes and blend modes.

features.title: A large effects library
features.text: Blur, color correction, distortion, generators, keying, particles and simulation, stylize and time effects.

features.title: Real 3D
features.text: 3D layers with cameras, depth of field, and lights that cast soft ray-traced shadows.

features.title: Expressions
features.text: JavaScript expressions with wiggle, loops and layer references, edited inline.

features.title: Export anywhere
features.text: H.264 and ProRes with alpha, PNG, TIFF and EXR sequences, GIF, and Lottie import and export.

details.headline: Page layout and publishing, rebuilt in pure Rust.
about: A native layout app with spreads, parent pages, threaded stories, styles, swatches, text wrap and a paragraph composer. No subscription, no license server and no telemetry.

features.title: The layout tools you know
features.text: Spreads and parent pages, frames and threaded stories, with paragraph and character styles.

features.title: Beautiful type
features.text: A Knuth–Plass paragraph composer, dictionary hyphenation, optical margin alignment and baseline grids, with line breaks that match on screen and in PDF.

features.title: Print-ready PDF
features.text: Real selectable text with embedded fonts, CMYK and spot colors, bleed, crop marks and PDF/A output.

features.title: Fast
features.text: Multithreaded rendering, instant undo and cached text composition.

features.title: Open formats
features.text: A documented native format, PNG export and layout interchange import and export.

features.title: Built for automation
features.text: Every menu item, tool, panel and dialog can be driven over a JSON control channel and an MCP server.

shots.caption: A magazine spread with a threaded story

details.headline: The familiar word processor, native and offline.
about: A word processor with the ribbon, shortcuts and behavior you already know, written in Rust. Open source, and built from public specifications.

features.title: Familiar
features.text: Ribbon tabs and groups, a live Styles gallery and the editing behavior you expect, from list continuation to Format Painter.

features.title: Your files
features.text: Opens and saves .docx, and also .odt, .rtf, .html, .md, .tex and .txt. Opens older .doc files and exports PDF with real, selectable text.

features.title: Fast
features.text: Paragraph layout is cached, so typing stays responsive even in long documents.

features.title: Private
features.text: Spelling, grammar and everything else work offline.

features.title: Everywhere
features.text: One Rust codebase for macOS, Windows, Linux, BSD and the web.

features.title: Built for agents
features.text: Every action is a command, driven from the ribbon, shortcuts, a command-line tool, a JSON control channel or an MCP server.

shots.caption: The Home tab and the Navigation pane

details.headline: Presentations, rebuilt in Rust.
about: A presentation app with slide masters, shapes, animations and a presenter view, written in Rust. In alpha, heading for beta.

features.title: Make decks
features.text: Slide masters and layouts with placeholders that inherit formatting, themes, sections, notes and comments.

features.title: Draw
features.text: Preset shapes with adjust handles, connectors that stay glued to shapes, freeform tools, merged shapes, gradients, shadows and glow.

features.title: Write
features.text: In-place text editing with full font and paragraph formatting, bullets and numbering, columns and autofit.

features.title: Add content
features.text: Pictures with crop and corrections, styled tables, charts, audio and video.

features.title: Present
features.text: Transitions including Morph, animations and motion paths, a full-screen slide show, presenter view and rehearsed timings.

features.title: Exchange files
features.text: Opens and saves PowerPoint .pptx and exports PDF (slides, notes pages and handouts), PNG and JPEG.

shots.caption: Editing a slide, with sections and notes

details.headline: Spreadsheets you already know how to use.
about: A spreadsheet with the ribbon, formula bar, sheet tabs and shortcuts you know, on a calculation engine written in Rust. No subscription, no license server and no telemetry.

features.title: Familiar
features.text: The ribbon, formula bar, Name Box, fill handle, point-mode formulas, Format Cells, Paste Special, conditional formatting, tables and charts.

features.title: Compatible
features.text: XLSX is the native format, with formulas, tables, conditional formats, charts, pivot tables and print settings round-tripping. CSV and TSV too.

features.title: Capable
features.text: A dependency-graph calculation engine with dynamic arrays, LET and LAMBDA, structured table references, sort, AutoFilter and Flash Fill.

features.title: Fast
features.text: Copy-on-write workbooks, incremental recalculation and a grid that only lays out what is on screen.

features.title: Agent-native
features.text: Every ribbon button, menu item, dialog and keystroke is a command, available over a JSON control channel, an MCP server or the CLI.

features.title: Everywhere
features.text: One Rust codebase for the desktop and the web.

details.headline: Computer-aided drafting, in pure Rust.
about: A drafting app with the command line, object snaps and workflow that drafters already know. Free, with no account and no subscription. In early, fast development.

features.title: The workflow you know
features.text: Type L, click two points, type @5<45 and press Enter. Prompts with clickable keywords, polar tracking, direct distance entry and grips work the way drafting habit expects.

features.title: Open files
features.text: Reads and writes DXF natively (R12 through 2018) and opens and saves DWG (R13 through 2018) with the open-source acadrust library. Exports SVG and PNG.

features.title: Fast and native
features.text: Pure Rust and egui, with no Electron and no web view.

features.title: A full drafting toolset
features.text: Draw, modify, dimension, hatch and block commands, layers with a properties manager, paper-space layouts and PDF plotting.

features.title: Built for agents
features.text: Every menu item, tool and prompt is a command, available over MCP, a JSON control channel or the CLI.

details.headline: Recording, editing and mixing, in Rust.
about: A digital audio workstation that follows the workflow audio engineers already know: an Edit window for arranging and editing, and a Mix window for balancing. Pre-alpha.

features.title: Editing
features.text: Shuffle, Slip, Spot and Grid modes, Smart, Grabber, Trim and other tools, fades and crossfades, playlists with comping lanes and clip gain.

features.title: Mixing
features.text: Faders and pans with automation, sends, busses, aux inputs, VCA masters, routing folders and automatic plugin delay compensation.

features.title: Automation
features.text: Volume, pan, mute, send and every plugin parameter, with Write, Touch, Latch and Trim passes recorded live from the faders.

features.title: Plugins
features.text: EQ, dynamics, reverbs, modulation effects, a subtractive synth and a drum synth, all original, and CLAP plugins load too.

shots.caption: The Edit window with a nine-track session

details.headline: Interface design and prototyping, in pure Rust.
about: Design screens, components and prototypes in a native app that opens instantly and works offline, with no account and no telemetry. Early alpha.

features.title: Auto layout
features.text: Rows, columns, wrap and grids with padding, gaps and Hug, Fill or Fixed sizing, plus constraints and layout grids.

features.title: Components
features.text: Instances with overrides, variants and properties, styles, and variables with modes bound to fills, strokes and effects.

features.title: Vectors
features.text: Real vector networks, the pen and pencil, the shape builder, editable booleans and variable width strokes.

features.title: Prototypes
features.text: Connections, triggers and animated transitions, variables with conditionals, flows and a presentation view with device frames.

features.title: Hand off
features.text: Inspect mode with measurements, annotations, ready-for-dev status, and code for CSS, HTML, React, SwiftUI and Compose.

features.title: Your files
features.text: Plain .figcraft files on your own disk. SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP and PDF in and out, and .fig files open, best effort.
